card.name: Partway through long medical words
card.fires_on: Fires on a piece in the middle or end of a long, rare word that is not yet complete, such as immunoglob-ul-ins, exacer-b-ation or hydroxyure-a. It also fires on a Lao script character.

modes.label: Unfinished medical terms
modes.description: A piece inside a long medical term where the rest of the word must still follow.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B

modes.label: Lao script letters
modes.description: A vowel character inside Lao words in a description of a national motto.
modes.example: ສັນຕິພາບ ເ<<ອ>>ກະລາດ ປ

card.writes: It suppresses line breaks and punctuation, which fits a word that must continue, but adds no clear content.
card.plain: It marks a spot where a long medical word is still unfinished, so the text cannot end there.
